package.name: udl_aa_ss
package.description:
Safety stack for the ArduPilot autonomy stack. Runs one thread per safety condition, ranks their verdicts, and runs a safety sequence in response, commanding the vehicle over its own topics - which the flight stack prioritises above the flight commander's.
A peer of udl_aa_fc rather than a layer under it: it depends on the topic contract exposed by udl_aa_fs and never on the flight commander, so the safety stack cannot be broken by a change to the thing it overrides.
